A curated index of open-source Grand Theft Auto VI reverse engineering tools for Rockstar's RAGE 9 engine: 
 RPF9 archive explorers, TTPF texture and ADAT/AWC audio decoders, 
 byte-level format specs, and Xbox Series (Scarlett) / PS5 translation layers.

 Textures & Audio ·
 Recomp & Shims ·
 Format Docs ·
 Glossary ·
 Safety & Scope 
 

 [!WARNING]
 No playable GTA VI for PC exists. Any download, installer, or launcher that says otherwise is fake or malware. Details, and what this list will not link.

 Ecosystem Overview

Everything starts with an RPF9 archive. Explorers open it, then each payload type has its own decoders. Most active work targets the Xbox Series X S (Scarlett) RAGE 9 stack, since Xbox Series runs on x86-64 Zen 2 with RDNA2 (GFX10.3) shaders and a Windows-derived Game OS ( d3d12 xs , kernelx ). Early PS5 library-translation efforts exist as well.

 
 
 

---

 RPF9 Archive & Asset Explorers

Tools and libraries for inspecting, browsing, salvaging, and exporting RPF9 containers, 3D drawables ( glTF / OBJ ), map placements, and embedded media.

 Project                                         What it does 
 :--- :--- 
 PercyStar   Rust · Windows, macOS, Linux Fast RPF9 explorer with Bink 2 video (docked D3D11 on Windows), ADAT Opus audio, a world map tab, a streaming 3D world view, an AWC player, and vehicle configurations. v1.5.2 adds a typed PSIN XML viewer with hashed-name recovery and a vehicle handling panel. 
 Percy6Stars   Rust · macOS, Windows, Linux Cross-platform PercyStar fork with macOS and Linux support, in-app BK2 video and audio playback (via bink2-decoder on Linux), AWC audio previews, 3D model browsing, and a .ttpf thumbnail gallery with BCPack BC1 support. 
 SixNG   Rust ( GPL-3.0 ) · CLI + GUI, cross-platform Exports models to glTF , textures, and map data, and streams the whole map in a 3D view. Decodes BCPack textures in all six BC formats (some BC7/BC6H blocks can speckle). Since v0.6 it also exports rigged characters with animation clips, strand hair and fur, cloth, particle effects, and the 4.2 M localised text strings. v0.7.0 ships Linux and macOS builds. 
 6stars   Swift, Metal · macOS · no license file yet Native engine that streams the world straight from your own RPF9 archives: full LOD hierarchy, interiors, vegetation, timecycle lighting and weather. Ships an rpftool CLI too. 
 rpf9-explorer   C · Windows Archive browser with model, texture, audio, and video previews and asset export. v1.3 adds assembled vehicle previews and BCPack decoding for BC1, BC3, BC4, and BC5 (BC6H/BC7 not yet). Used as a submodule by Leonida . 
 6to5m   Rust ( GPL-3.0 ) · CLI + MCP server, cross-platform The only GTA VI → GTA V / FiveM converter so far. Turns map areas into FiveM resources with BCPack textures, collision, LOD placements, MLO interiors with decoded portals, navmesh, vehicles, weapons, and peds. 
 vice-lens   Rust ( MIT ) · Windows, Linux Desktop explorer with a map of placements, 3D models, vehicles, animated characters, textures, Bink movies, audio and text, and glTF / PNG / Opus / MP4 export. Finds files by scanning for zlib streams, so it needs no table of contents. BCPack-only mips are not decoded yet. 
 gta6-explorer   Python ( MIT ) · CLI, cross-platform Read-only, dependency-free toolkit covering RPF9, TTPF textures to DDS/PNG, Bink and AWC carving, PSIN schemas, shader recovery and name-hash dictionaries, with a 189-check self-test. BCPack is partial (BC1 from bcpack-rs , provisional BC3/4/5); models go through a SixNG binary you supply. 
 OpenRPF9   C ( MIT ) · Windows Small WinForms inspector that carves compressed streams straight out of an archive (no table of contents needed) and shows them as hex, text or XML. Also opens standalone .ttpf files with plain BC1-BC7 decoding and PNG export, and remuxes AWC Opus. No BCPack. 
 rpf9-extract   Rust · CLI, cross-platform Clean-room CLI extractor and inspector ( -n list, -v header fields and PSIN tables). 
 zeozeozeo/rpf9   Rust · library crate Minimal clean-room Rust library implementing the RPF9 archive format with runnable examples/ . 

---

 Texture ( .ttpf ) & Audio ( ADAT / AWC) Tools

Focused decoders for RAGE 9 GPU-tiled texture packs ( .ttpf , BCPack , Gfx10 swizzling), audio containers ( ADAT / AWC Opus and XMA2 banks), and Bink 2 ( .bk2 ) media.

 Project                                                       What it does 
 :--- :--- 
 ttpf-studio   Python · GUI, cross-platform View, export, and replace .ttpf textures (BC1-BC7, GPU unswizzling, headerless scan recovery). Also recovers RPF9 files, exports models to OBJ, and plays Bink video. v1.1 adds a GPU 3D view that assembles whole vehicles with their own paint, rims and tyres. 
 ttpf-viewer   Rust ( MIT ) · Windows; macOS / Linux from source Fast .ttpf gallery and extractor with exact Gfx10 tile/mip layouts, 3D cube maps, and PNG or lossless DDS export. Documents the RDS5 / ETPF header. BCPack-only mips are not decodable yet. 
 bcpack-rs   Rust, Python ( MIT OR Apache-2.0 ) · CLI, cross-platform Standalone clean-room decoder for BCPack , the Xbox Series texture compression. BC1 decodes and is checked on held-out data. The entropy layer also converges exactly for BC3 through BC7; their block decoders are in progress.
